question: Describe the MVC architecture.
user_answer: Model-View-Controller (MVC) is a software design pattern that divides applications into three interconnected components—Model (data), View (UI), and Controller (logic)—to separate business logic from user interface, enhancing scalability and maintainability. It enables parallel development, where developers can work on data, UI, and functionality independently.

question: What is the Document Object Model (DOM)?
user_answer: The Document Object Model (DOM) is a programming interface for web documents that represents HTML or XML as a structured tree of nodes, allowing languages like JavaScript to dynamically access, change, and update the content, structure, and style of a page. It is created by the browser as an object-oriented representation of the page, turning HTML elements into manipulatable objects.
